final_agent_message:
Implemented case-insensitive default template autoescaping.

- `select_jinja_autoescape` now lowercases filenames before checking the existing supported suffixes.
- Added regression coverage for mixed/uppercase `.HTML`, `.HTM`, `.Xml`, `.XhTmL`, and `.SvG`, plus unchanged `.txt` and `None` behavior.
- Completed the Keelson change workflow and landed its behavior contract.

Verification commands run:

- `PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests/test_templating.py -q` — 39 passed
- `PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-pydeps python3 -m pytest tests -q` — 498 passed
- `keelson check --trust --record "Default autoescaping recognizes supported filename suffixes case-insensitively; unsupported names and None retain their behavior."` — passed (runs the provisioned full test command)
- `git diff --check` — passed

I also temporarily reverted the normalization and ran the templating tests; the four mixed-case suffix cases failed, confirming the regression test distinguishes the fix.
